model: muse-spark-1.3 (Meta Model API), the photo marking prompt in witness/src/witness_photo.erl
paper: sample paper made for the demo (not a real student): Year 9 Mathematics, Percentages and Money, 2 pages photographed on a desk

question_4.diagnosis: Thought a 50% increase and a 50% decrease cancel to return to the original price.

steps_as_read: Half up, half down. Same price.

fingerprint.ask: You wrote 'Half up, half down' – half of what amount each time?
evidence: Half up, half down. Same price.
fingerprint.intervention: Have the student work each step in dollars: first find the price after the 50% increase, then find 50% of that new price.
fingerprint.reasoning: Reasoned that half up then half down must return to the same price without calculating each change.
